title: Prisma Migrations
description: Learn Prisma Migrate dev, deploy, reset, seed scripts, and migration strategies for teams and CI/CD.
longDescription: Migrations keep your database schema in sync with your Prisma schema. This module covers the three main migration commands (dev, deploy, reset), how to write seed scripts, and strategies for managing migrations in team environments and CI/CD pipelines.
whatYouLearn: Use prisma migrate dev for local development
Deploy migrations with prisma migrate deploy
Reset the database with prisma migrate reset
